parrafo.es: Jon y su equipo suben, cortan y retiran arboles enteros en Tallahassee con equipo propio de primera: grua elevadora, triturador y cargador. Sus clientes en Google destacan que dejan el jardin limpio, sin escombros.
parrafo.en: Jon and his crew climb, cut and remove entire trees around Tallahassee with their own top notch equipment: a bucket truck, a chipper and a loader. His Google reviewers point out they leave the yard clean, debris free.

parrafo_1.es: Jon's Tree Services lleva años retirando y podando arboles en Tallahassee. Trabajan con grua elevadora, cargador y triturador propios para operaciones grandes y complicadas.
parrafo_1.en: Jon's Tree Services has spent years removing and trimming trees around Tallahassee. They run their own bucket truck, loader and chipper for big, complicated jobs.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google repiten lo mismo: profesionales, puntuales y dejan el terreno limpio de escombros al terminar. Primera estimacion siempre gratis.
parrafo_2.en: Google reviewers say the same thing again and again: professional, punctual, and they leave the site debris free when they are done. The first estimate is always free.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que arbol necesita atencion y te damos una estimacion gratis y justa.
texto.en: Tell us which tree needs attention and we will give you a free, fair estimate.

texto.es: Evaluamos el arbol, el espacio y el equipo que hace falta antes de empezar.
texto.en: We evaluate the tree, the space and the equipment the job needs before we start.

texto.es: Subimos, cortamos y bajamos cada seccion con cuidado, protegiendo tu propiedad.
texto.en: We climb, cut and lower each section with care, protecting your property.

texto.es: Retiramos troncos y ramas y dejamos el terreno libre de escombros.
texto.en: We haul away the logs and branches and leave the site debris free.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el tamano y la dificultad del arbol. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the tree's size and difficulty. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Arboles completos, grandes o dificiles, retirados con grua elevadora y cargador propios.
texto.en: Full tree removal, big or difficult, handled with our own bucket truck and loader.

texto.es: Poda de ramas altas y recorte para la salud y seguridad de tus arboles.
texto.en: High branch trimming and pruning for the health and safety of your trees.

texto.es: Disponibles para retirar arboles y ramas caidas tras una tormenta.
texto.en: Available to clear fallen trees and branches after a storm.

texto.es: Nos llevamos troncos y ramas, tu jardin queda libre de escombros.
texto.en: We haul away the logs and branches, your yard stays debris free.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llamanos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call us anyway and we will quote it.

items.quote: Talk about a 5-star service, Jon's tree service DELIVERS! Jon and his staff are professional, efficient, knowledgeable, courteous and friendly. They are experts. Jon listens well to your needs and provides a free and fair estimate.

I have used Jon's Tree Service for several tree removals over the years. His equipment is top notch. His crews are courteous and do a great job of cleaning up and leaving a debris free jobsite. I recommend them for removal and pruning work.

First time homeowner here. I knew I had some trees that needed to be taken care of and I am so glad we chose this company! Extremely professional and turned out even better than I thought! Showed up at 8 and gone by noon, 4 trees removed.

parrafo.es: Una llamada y te damos la estimacion gratis. Sin compromiso.
parrafo.en: One call and we will get you a free estimate. No strings attached.
